method_notes: Guide to Primary Education in Barnet 2027, 'Admission criteria for community primary schools in Barnet', Note 3: 'Distance is measured in a straight line between the address point for the child's home, supplied by Ordnance Survey, to the school's main gate (unless specified otherwise) using the Council's computerised geographical information system.' Community schools offer places first to children in the school's defined area (closest first), then to children outside it. The voluntary aided, free, foundation and academy schools set their own criteria (many faith-based, some with lotteries); their summaries in the guide also measure in a straight line. The council tables give the criterion under which the last place was offered: where that was a faith or lottery criterion, no places went on distance alone (no_distance_offers); where it was an open, community-band or 'any other applicant' criterion, the figure is recorded as a distance.

gaps: 2024, 2025 and 2026 figures were transcribed from PDFs downloaded by hand. The 2027 guide's URL is assumed from its filename (bc5313_-_guide_to_primary_2027_final_0.pdf) and was not checked. Community schools: where the in-area column shows a distance and the outside column 'None', the figure applies only to children living in the school's defined area (noted per school); the defined-area maps are not in the data. Parish/catchment cut-offs at faith schools (St Andrew's, St John's N20 2024, St Mary's East Barnet, The Hyde 2024/2026) likewise apply only inside that area. St Catherine's 2025 ('Any other applicant - Sibling') counts as a sibling criterion. Blessed Dominic 2025/2026 ('Other Faiths') is treated as a faith criterion. Holy Trinity is missing from the 2025 VA table (not_published); its 2026 places figure is blank in the table (PAN 30 from 2024). Bell Lane (2024) and Broadfields (2024) are recorded under their Saracens names. Barnet Hill Academy and Nancy Reuben are not in any year's tables. School list from GIAS; juniors, nursery, special and independent schools excluded.
